title: Trainer level scaling
description: How trainers' Pokémon scale to the player's party level (Conditions_PartyLevel), by tier (docs/paperwhite2/plugins.md, Trainer scaling). A team's ace goes to the party level + top, and each other Pokémon keeps its original gap below the ace but goes no lower than the party level + bottom. The difficulty's levels come after, for the opponents (level_scaling.json's difficulty_*).

tiers.description: The tiers, each a team's levels from the party's level

name.description: Its name, which classes and trainers give; not "fixed", which means not scaled

top.description: The team's ace's level, from the party's level

bottom.description: The lowest any of the team goes, from the party's level; at most top

below_original.description: Whether a Pokémon may go below its original level, for a player below it

default_tier.description: The tier of a class that classes doesn't list

ally_tier.description: The tier of a partner on the player's side (a multi battle's ally), whatever its class

classes.description: Classes and their tier, or "fixed" for not scaled

trainers.description: Trainers whose tier isn't their class's, or "fixed" for not scaled

badge_floor.description: For 0 to 8 badges, the least party level trainers scale from: the lowest level of the last Gym Leader beaten, so an under-levelled party doesn't make the story's trainers trivial
